findings.issue: The retry counter is incremented before the attempt directory is created, so a dispatch that dies leaves the budget spent and the attempt absent
findings.evidence: src/controller.js:212 increments `retries` and src/controller.js:227 creates the directory; nothing between them is guarded, and the intervening call can throw.

reproduction.expected: retries unchanged when the attempt directory was never created
reproduction.observed: retries: 1 with no attempt_2/ on disk
